about: SYNTHETIC paraphrases written for this test, one per stored Windows row; no third-party text. Each keeps the structure the link rule reads (build position, cue words, sentence breaks, spec labels, the title-copy opening) and names its stored original only by (update_version, target_build, question id). Equivalence with the originals is checked by diagnose_windows_link_roles.py --fixture-equivalence, never by the governed suite.
text_rule: text = parent_title + report_title + report_text_excerpt, a trailing '...' removed
